SIG-MEM-001.text: At a round boundary, reconcile the actual landed predecessor against the proposed dependency map and record demonstrated defects, hypotheses, already-closed seams and still-owed work separately. A planning branch must not advance another active orchestrator’s control state. Every new requirement has exactly one implementation owner and an explicit verification domain.

SIG-TRUST-001.text: The production assertion interface must preserve typed value, raw lexical value, unit, scope, valid time, epistemic axes, sensitivity, compartment and derivation/correction links. Defaults require a named versioned mapping and an explicit basis; absent fields must not silently become stronger evidence or lower sensitivity. Unknown predicate/type combinations fail closed or enter an explicit quarantine, without making an otherwise valid entity disappear.

SIG-TRUST-002.text: Every newly asserted claim and live re-sighting must bind the actual captured artifact consumed by extraction, including digest, retrieval time, extractor/config identity and a typed locator or an explicit document-only limitation. Replay retains original observation time and separately records replay assertion time. Legacy synthetic provenance remains identified as legacy; exact replayability must be measured, not inferred from source_id presence.

SIG-TRUST-003.text: Publishers, hosts, operators, owners, vendors, prime contractors, funders and access partners must remain distinct roles unless evidence explicitly relates them. Templates, recommendations, awards, subscriptions and deployments retain their different legal/operational status. Count comparison requires compatible subject, capability, population, geography, time and measurement basis; approximate derived sums preserve their inputs, arithmetic and uncertainty.

SIG-TRUST-004.text: Organization resolution must prefer scoped external identifiers and treat normalized-name-only identities as review candidates when jurisdiction or institutional scope is unknown or ambiguous. Repairing an existing false union or split must append reviewed identity dispositions and stable-id redirects; it must not overwrite historical entities, keys or claims. A source publisher label is not an identity proof for the observed operator.

SIG-TRUST-005.text: Resolver, reconciliation, camera-site materialization, API and export must share one versioned temporal eligibility contract. Eligible occurrences are bounded by belief time and asserted valid-world time; retrieval-time fallback is labeled. Select the latest establishing occurrence within each source assertion/source-record lineage, preserving concurrent independent candidates and atomic fields; explicit resolution policy chooses or abstains. Selection uses occurrence time and deterministic tie-breakers, not claim-id order. Later captures cannot alter a past-belief answer, and A→B→A, replays, corrections and equal timestamps must have cross-consumer conformance tests.

SIG-TRUST-006.text: Every public consumer, including indexes, tiles, analytics and relationship endpoints, must apply the same reviewed eligibility/disposition policy. Publication-review flags, sensitivity, rights restrictions and correction/withdrawal state must be consumed, with a recorded policy version and reason. Withheld endpoints cannot leak through labels or edge topology. Historical claims remain append-only; legitimate public withdrawals yield an honest policy-controlled tombstone. Current access withdrawals override historical availability during activation, rollback and every operator-controlled origin/cache/artifact path; deny an unsafe whole artifact rather than rewrite bytes under its identity.

SIG-TRUST-007.text: A historical provenance and semantic audit must report a reproducible sampling frame and denominators for exact replayability, locatability, unsupported role mappings, count comparability and publication eligibility. Recovery requires preserved bytes plus provable lineage; unavailable evidence is reported explicitly and cannot be reconstructed by pretending a new fetch is the old capture. Repairs are bounded, resumable, dry-runnable and append-only.

SIG-TRUST-008.text: Production recovery and activation must execute from a reviewed, resource-bounded plan with pinned code, input selection, before/after inventory, idempotence proof and rollback via new dispositions or prior released artifacts. Source-rights and operational approvals remain binding. Calendar-dependent checks, including the reserved 2026-10-10 replay, cannot be marked complete before their observed execution.

SIG-TRUST-009.text: A new public release requires a complete release candidate, change/withholding summary, verified source and publication authority, evaluation disclosure, tested intake operating ownership, and the existing human publication gate. Publication must be atomic, followed by unauthenticated verification against expected digests and a tested prior-release rollback. A planning artifact, successful build or agent judgment cannot sign this gate.

SIG-MEM-002.text: Current obligation and requirement assessments must be derived from explicit evidence-backed transitions, retaining historical statuses and scope-specific assessments. Conflicting legacy status text requires recorded reconciliation; ambiguity stays open. A deterministic current-state view records input hashes and revision, separates fixture/DB/hosted/public evidence, lists every outstanding owner/landing, and detects stale inputs without modifying the control ledger.

SIG-MEM-003.text: Build validation and closeout must be safe across worktrees: reports have unique or caller-selected destinations and input identities; control writes use expected-state preconditions and a scoped single-writer protocol. Idempotent recovery keyed by ticket, implementation revision and PR identity must handle interruption between code and memory commits without duplicate advancement, duplicate PR creation or invented closure. Every worker and orchestrator repair path shares one authoritative chain-head check and a prepared/external-known/memory-committed/acknowledged operation protocol. Atomicity is at a validated git tree/commit, not arbitrary uncommitted files; workflow activation stays shadow-only until a verified operator-approved cutover.

SIG-MEM-004.text: Repository and agent guidance must state the current implemented architecture and the governing ADR supersession chain, with tested command references. Compact orientation views must preserve links to obligations and full history; they cannot replace mandatory ticket loads or erase uncertainty. Documentation refresh follows actual implementation and validates the nearest-file instruction hierarchy.

SIG-EVAL-001.text: Resolution evaluation must use a preregistered campaign with a frozen source snapshot, explicit target population, sampling frame, inclusion probabilities, strata, grouping, split assignment, seed and ruleset identity. Training, calibration and sealed test sets must be separated at entity/component and duplicated upstream-record lineage boundaries; whole source families are held out when claiming unseen-family generalization. A changed model or unblinded test set requires a new evaluation decision; tuning on the test set is prohibited.

SIG-EVAL-002.text: Independent human labels must be recorded append-only with pseudonymous reviewer identity, evidence references, reason and one of same-device, different-device or insufficient-evidence. Reviewers are blinded to model/previous-label predictions during first pass; two independent labels and an adjudication process preserve disagreements and abstentions. Evaluation labels are distinct from operational accept/reject decisions; agents and LLMs cannot impersonate human adjudication.

SIG-EVAL-003.text: Reports must distinguish auto-positive precision, candidate-generation recall, whole-cluster quality and labelability. They must state numerator, denominator, sampling weights, uncertainty method and population limits. Unresolved/missing evidence cannot be dropped to improve a gate. Correlated pairs and enriched diagnostic samples cannot be treated as independent representative Bernoulli trials without a justified design; a pair sample alone cannot establish whole-cluster recall.

SIG-EVAL-004.text: Auto-write eligibility must use a preregistered lower confidence bound of at least 0.98 on strict precision for each authorized tier, with simultaneous-error control across tested tiers and a fixed sampling/stopping rule. Insufficient evidence demotes or retains provisional/review-only status. The interval method must match the sampling design; point estimates, favorable resampling and optional stopping cannot establish eligibility. LLM agreement is supplementary, never a substitute for human ground truth.

SIG-EVAL-005.text: A rule/threshold candidate must be derived only from development/calibration data and frozen before its confirmatory sampling frame is drawn. After the independent final campaign, evaluate that fixed candidate once, with a new ADR recording losses, coverage, uncertainty, failures and rollback. Further candidate changes after unsealing require a new independent frame/sample/campaign. Human decisions must be verified through the P31 review-to-clustering seam; failed/inconclusive assessments retain provisional disclosures and owed deferrals.

SIG-EVAL-006.text: Published evaluation claims must identify exactly the tiers, populations, geography/source mix, model/ruleset and time window supported by the assessment. Drift in input mix, extraction semantics or matching rules triggers reassessment; successful evaluation of selected camera-site tiers cannot certify organization identities, all graph edges or overall surveillance coverage.

SIG-ACQ-001.text: Source discovery must start from a named evidence/question/relationship gap or justified national need, record search provenance and access checks, and distinguish existing registry entries, planned P31 work, mirrors and genuinely new candidates. Candidate value is measured as supported new relationships or closed gaps after deduplication, not raw claim volume.

SIG-ACQ-002.text: A candidate must carry authority, target predicates, scope/time, lineage independence, extractability, refresh cost, rights basis and Part VIII preflight before prioritization. Rights and sensitive-data barriers are hard gates, not scores that usefulness can offset. Raw document licensing, factual extraction and public derived-artifact licensing must be assessed separately; municipal publication alone does not imply federal public-domain status.

SIG-ACQ-003.text: New acquisition adapters must use the existing connector stages, typed assertion contract, capture store and fail-closed loader. Fixtures must include templates versus executed instruments, publication versus effective dates, subscriptions versus hardware, contractor roles, exceptions and missing/redacted fields. New source rows default to ingestion_permitted=false; fixture success neither clears rights nor proves live access.

SIG-ACQ-004.text: A bounded source pilot must publish selection rationale, actual access/capture/extraction/link/publication funnel, unique evidence-lineage contribution, review burden, cost and maintenance outcome. A stop/continue decision must use measured gap closure and failure reasons. Sources owned by P31 are consumed or improved rather than onboarded a second time, and no public-records request or outreach is sent without explicit authority.

SIG-FIND-001.text: Public records and citations must bind an immutable release manifest pinning input snapshot, code, ontology, policy, ruleset, world/belief cutoffs, compartment licenses, artifact digests and completeness. A pre-render namespace hashes canonical ID-free projection roots and interpretation/renderer inputs; a separate final integrity digest covers emitted artifact checksums, avoiding self-reference. Serialization and atomic latest-pointer publication are specified. Release-specific content never silently changes; a withdrawn or unavailable artifact returns an honest tombstone or unavailable state.

SIG-FIND-002.text: Every eligible public record must have a release- and compartment-specific stable route and evidence/claim anchors, with no-JS access. A citation resolves the represented released bytes and interpretation. Unsupported historical selectors are explicitly rejected or mapped to a real release; an ignored query string cannot masquerade as an as-of answer. Record materialization costs must be measured before production rollout.

SIG-FIND-003.text: Search must cover all eligible records in the selected release and compartment, including records without locations, with named totals, exact-id lookup, bounded pagination and specific record links. Index construction and query serving preserve compartment/suppression boundaries and release consistency. Full-corpus discovery cannot be implemented as an unlabeled first-N sample or a current-only API behind a historical page.

SIG-FIND-004.text: The existing map/search/network islands must share versioned URL state for release, compartment, query, filters and focused record, restore browser navigation and link to equivalent static records/lists. Connections expose qualified edge evidence and bounded expansion; map proximity and graph reachability cannot imply identity or observed access. P31 tile/compression work and the no-basemap decision remain in force.

SIG-FIND-005.text: Public static routes and no-JS pagination must meet the existing 150 KiB/zero-script budget; enhanced routes use explicit per-island budgets and retain complete equivalent navigation. Real-sized release fixtures, WCAG 2.2 AA checks, keyboard flow, back/forward state and missing-location records are required acceptance cases. Budget failures must be repaired or explicitly decided, never hidden by testing only demo data.

SIG-FIND-006.text: Anonymous correction intake must provide a durable receipt and restricted moderation workflow independent of claim-spine writes. The first receiver accepts bounded allowlisted fields without uploads or server-side URL fetches, minimizes personal data, enforces abuse/retention controls and preserves reviewer-only publication decisions. Public status/log views contain redacted reviewed dispositions, not raw submissions or private receipt/contact information.

SIG-FIND-007.text: The public acceptance portfolio must demonstrate place-to-record-to-evidence, relationship-to-qualified-claim, immutable citation and correction-to-reviewed-disposition journeys on the three dossiers and records outside the old sample. Results distinguish automated conformance, agent walkthroughs and actual independent user testing; missing user participation cannot be represented as usability validation.

SIG-DOS-001.text: Each research dossier must answer a fixed schema covering capability, owned/accessed hardware, actors and roles, procurement/funding, legal/operational authority, retention, access/sharing, use/oversight, decision dates, changes and unknowns. Every answer has scope/time and a supported, disputed, derived, unknown, withheld or not-applicable state with evidence; absence of an answer is not evidence of absence.

SIG-DOS-002.text: Dossier completion requires a fact-to-capture ledger, source search log, comparability review, currentness assessment and an independent adversarial check of every answer class. Publication is blocked by unsupported affirmative claims, misclassified instruments or unconsumed restrictions. Honest documented unknowns are permitted and must generate specific follow-up tasks rather than artificial completeness scores. The pilot uses the fixed twelve-question S2 rubric: at least 28/36, questions 1/5/7/8 at least 2, with material governance/contract/relationship assertions independently reviewed. Incomplete publication is a distinct explicitly accepted scope and does not satisfy pilot completion.

SIG-DOS-003.text: The Oklahoma City dossier must distinguish city-owned cameras, private city cameras, metro observations and partner-agency access; label the approximate derived city sum and do not display it as contradictory to a metro count. It must separately establish dates/scope of retention and sharing provisions, renewal terms and applicability of UVED law, preserving exceptions and unknowns. Secondary reports cannot be labeled executed contracts or council minutes.

SIG-DOS-004.text: The Tulsa dossier must separate the public private-camera MOU template from any demonstrated executed agreement, distinguish policy effective dates from capture dates, and leave unsupported counts, spend, sharing and usage unknown. A template proves terms offered, not adoption or an active partner relationship. Completeness includes a precise request/research plan for unavailable facts without sending it automatically.

SIG-DOS-005.text: The San Diego dossier must distinguish the physical ALPR/streetlight system from subscription-only access to external plate data, identify prime/subcontractor roles only with evidence, and separate annual self-report, oversight recommendation and enacted policy. Network audit data receives a structural Part VIII preflight before any row-level acquisition; public aggregate evidence never licenses person/plate ingestion.

SIG-TRUST-010.text: After the final evaluation decision, materialize the selected or safely demoted rules against the frozen approved inputs and regenerate all affected graph, dossier, record, index, tile and analytics artifacts into one new release candidate. Every artifact must pin the same evaluation result, ruleset and snapshot. Pre-evaluation previews cannot satisfy release acceptance; any changed evaluation-relevant inputs require an explicit reassessment decision.

SIG-FIND-008.text: An authorized moderation decision must have an idempotent, audited bridge to the canonical append-only correction/disposition workflow, recording submission, proposal, validation, applied assertion/disposition and resulting release identities. The public receiver has no authority to apply it. A receipt is not a correction, and review completion is distinct from application and publication; crashes/retries cannot duplicate or bypass any transition.

SIG-EVAL-007.text: Select and freeze the candidate matcher using development/calibration evidence before defining and drawing its confirmatory auto-positive sampling frame. Pin ruleset, eligible edge/tier populations, inclusion probabilities, grouping, sample sizes, seed and hypothesis family before final human labeling. A candidate change that introduces different positives invalidates the old frame; freeze and redraw a new independent assessment rather than carry unsupported inclusion probabilities. Development and final human work have separate markers/readouts.

Static pages meet zero-script/150-KiB budget on full-sized fixtures; existing island budgets and P31 tile contracts hold; keyboard and WCAG 2.2 AA checks pass.
Graph edge detail distinguishes configured access from observed use and exposes supporting claims; compartment switching updates data and attribution.

tickets.title: Deliver durable anonymous correction intake and private moderation
deliverables: Own isolated submission/receipt/moderation storage and a public receiver role with no claim-spine or curator writes; keep existing curation loopback-only.
Implement no-JS form, allowlisted record/release/evidence-reference fields, bounded narrative, receipt secret and safe status transitions; no uploads or server-side URL fetches.

Define abuse limits, ephemeral rate identifiers, retention/purge policy, redaction, operating owner and review-response disclosure; prepare deployment/operating gate packet rather than assuming staffing.
acceptance: Submit→restart→receipt→authorized moderation survives durably; duplicate retries are idempotent and receipt ids do not enumerate others.
Oversized/spam/script/plate-person payload fixtures cannot enter a public log or claim; rejected fields and moderator redaction have defined safe behavior.
Receiver credential cannot write claims/review decisions; public status exposes no raw text/contact/network identifiers; unstaffed/unapproved receiver cannot be advertised as operational.

tickets.title: Apply approved corrections through the canonical disposition path
deliverables: Own restricted proposal validation/application bridge from durable moderation to the canonical S1 correction/disposition API or CLI. Separate receipt/review/application/publication status and reference ids.
Validate reviewer authority, original record/release/evidence, proposed predicate/value/scope and current rights/sensitivity policy; require explicit approval before applying.
Append application audit/receipt and connect resulting release/public correction log after publication. Do not grant receiver claim/review writes or auto-apply reporter text.
acceptance: Approve→apply→restart→retry yields one canonical disposition and one stable applied receipt; failed/uncertain transaction reconciles by operation id.
Unauthorized, stale-record, changed-evidence and unsafe-payload proposals fail without graph mutation; moderator denial does not silently change facts.
A published correction points to old/new assertion and release identities or safe tombstones; received/reviewed/applied/unpublished states are visibly distinct.
tickets.gate: engineering only; real corrections require authorized curator decision and existing publication policy
tickets.live: offline-only; production application later in explicitly approved scope

tickets.title: Define and render evidence-complete dossier portfolios
deliverables: Own dossier answer schema, fact-to-capture ledger, question-level absence/state rules and independent completion checklist.

acceptance: Every question appears with a valid state and evidence/search basis; blank fields cannot inflate completeness or imply absence.
Unsupported affirmative claim or misclassified instrument fails dossier release validation; honest researched unknowns pass with specific follow-up.
Print/no-JS output preserves qualifiers and citations; same-scope conflicting evidence remains visible.
Fixed twelve-question rubric yields >=28/36 with questions 1/5/7/8 >=2 for pilot completeness; lower results stay incomplete and cannot satisfy the portfolio gate.

tickets.title: Complete the Oklahoma City dossier and seed correction packet

acceptance: Independent reviewer can trace every affirmative/derived answer to qualified source spans or sees an unresolved limitation.
299 versus 190 is not rendered a genuine count contradiction; 90 owned is not automatically 90 active; journalism is not executed-contract evidence.
Future-effective UVED language is not generalized to unrelated Flock use; no legal conclusion is inferred from the page alone.
tickets.gate: HG-03/source and evidence-use review for any new capture; HG-11 only at public release
tickets.live: operator-gated: bounded dossier-source capture after rights; otherwise complete fixture/evidence packet and RETURN PASS

tickets.title: Complete the Tulsa dossier with template and policy distinctions

acceptance: Unsigned/template document creates no executed contract or actual sharing edge; policy effective and retrieval dates remain separate.
Unsupported counts/spend/partner/use are unknown with search evidence and precise next action, not zero or inferred affirmative.
No request is sent; review and publication packets preserve all gate-pending facts.
tickets.gate: HG-03/source and evidence-use review for new capture; HG-11 at release
tickets.live: operator-gated: bounded reviewed source capture; otherwise RETURN PASS

tickets.title: Complete the San Diego dossier across hardware and subscriptions

Oversight recommendation remains proposed unless enactment evidence exists; unverifiable signature is never called executed.
Metadata-only preflight cannot fetch raw workbook/plate/person/per-search content; safe annual aggregates can support the dossier. Independent question-level review documents exact acquisition scope.
tickets.gate: HG-03 plus Part VIII structural preflight; HG-11 at release
tickets.live: operator-gated: bounded reviewed documents/aggregate structure only; otherwise RETURN PASS

tickets.title: Measure a gap-closing acquisition pilot

Execute approved bounded live slices or produce exact gate packets; record capture/extraction/link/publication funnel and maintenance burden.

Optionally run the preregistered matched discovery comparison from S5 (two matched task pairs, 30 minutes per arm, same jurisdiction scope and independent blinded error review). If not run, label results descriptive only; neither before/after funnel nor a small exploratory comparison proves causal superiority.

Failed/403/rights-blocked targets remain visible with reasons and retry budget; no broad blind crawler runs.
Rights-gated live work has actual approval refs or explicit OPEN return-pass rows; fixture success cannot close live outcomes.
Candidate selection enforces all family/document/protocol ceilings and keeps rejected metadata-only SRC-027 outside the acquired batch.
tickets.gate: HG-03 for new/changed source rights; external access/budget approvals if needed
tickets.live: operator-gated: <=2 incremental non-portfolio families, <=10 approved documents/aggregate rows each, <=2 new protocol families; <=5 total families including three pilot cities; no unapproved spending

tickets.title: Apply bounded integrity recovery and rematerialize a release candidate
deliverables: Reconcile remaining legacy semantic/provenance repairs with actual retained captures and approved policy, then execute only an explicitly bounded selected scope.
Pin jobs, record before/after inventories/resource use and +0 rerun, and rematerialize in dependency order using the shared temporal/publication contract.

Freeze an unpublished repaired input snapshot/audit preview with actual source, schema and semantic rules identities; this is the frame for HUMAN-H4. It is not the final release candidate. Keep reserved batch-05 calendar verification unchanged.

Record which provisional production rules remain active versus new shadow eligibility results. Installing the evaluator does not itself activate a new gate or certify prior auto-writes; an approved safety demotion, if any, is explicitly scoped in this live packet.
acceptance: Dry-run and applied scope match; missing bytes never trigger undeclared refetch; checkpoint interruption and restart produce no duplicate repair.
Resource plan fits approved disk/runtime, no person/plate data appear, and every new fact/disposition binds evidence and authority.
Snapshot digest and population frame are frozen for HUMAN-H4; preview remains explicitly provisional. No public pointer or HG-11 decision is changed; final candidate belongs to P32.23a.
tickets.gate: operator operational approval and source/policy scope; HG-11 not yet exercised
tickets.live: operator-gated: explicit run/source/claim bounds, resource ceiling and abort threshold recorded before execution

tickets.title: Human development review and dossier semantic acceptance
deliverables: Operator assigns independent device-reference reviewers and a separate competent documentary semantic reviewer/adjudicator; records pseudonymous roles, rubric and approved effort budget.

Using P32.9 tooling and P32.22 repaired snapshot, complete training/pilot/calibration labels only; persist disagreements and insufficient evidence. These labels may inform candidate development and are excluded from the final confirmatory holdout.
Complete the fixed dossier rubric and material governance/contract/relationship semantic review; device-label expertise is not automatically legal/applicability expertise.
Record development label/snapshot digests, review limits, and unresolved gaps; release the development set to P32.22a without claiming a completed confirmatory evaluation.

Dossier semantic readout records scores, traced material assertions and unresolved applicability/execution issues.
No final confirmatory sample is drawn before P32.22a freezes the candidate and its eligible population; no pilot label is recycled as sealed test evidence.
tickets.gate: actual human development and dossier semantic review; never guessed past

Run the frozen candidate on the repaired snapshot and materialize its eligible auto-positive edges/tier frame, including attempted-versus-accepted union distinctions. Preregister statistical design, multiplicity, fixed stopping, sample sizes, seed and budgets.

Draw confirmatory sample and independent reference-neighborhood frame after candidate freeze with recorded inclusion probabilities/group boundaries; seal packet/denominator/manifest digests and transfer blinded packets to HUMAN-H5.
acceptance: A changed candidate adding new positives cannot reuse an earlier candidate-specific sample; test rejects stale frame and requires a fresh preregistration/draw.
Candidate rules and frame/population digests precede sample draw and all final labels; development examples cannot cross into final holdout.
Fixed sample plan matches chosen finite-population/independent/grouped design; no unaffordable/unavailable human budget is assumed approved.
tickets.gate: signed HUMAN-H4 development/dossier readout; operator confirms final campaign workload
tickets.live: offline-only over the frozen approved snapshot; no production rule activation

tickets.title: Complete blinded confirmatory adjudication for the frozen candidate
deliverables: Independent reviewers label the fixed P32.22a sample with model/prior-label predictions hidden; preserve same/different/insufficient and missingness in the original denominator.
Complete independent second labels and adjudication with evidence under the frozen rubric; record deviations, blinding breaches and label corrections without overwriting history.
Seal final label watermark/digests, reviewer attestations and campaign completion. Transfer the unopened confirmatory set for P32.23 evaluation of the already-frozen candidate only.
acceptance: Signed readout identifies candidate, snapshot, sample and label digests; no unapproved extra draws, excluded failures or reused development labels.
Incomplete/missing/insufficient labels remain represented; actual human work is never supplied by agents; incomplete campaign does not satisfy the gate.
tickets.gate: actual independent confirmatory human work; never guessed past

tickets.title: Re-derive resolution decisions from independent human evidence
deliverables: Consume the signed HUMAN-H5 campaign once to evaluate the exact candidate frozen before sampling by P32.22a. No candidate selection, rule tuning, extra draws or model-development feedback precedes this final evaluation on the held-out labels.

Write a measured ADR and drift/rollback policy from this single preregistered evaluation, preserving inconclusive/fail outcomes. Any new candidate after seeing the result requires a new independent frame/sample/campaign; final graph/release rematerialization belongs to P32.23a.
Verify actual human operational decisions propagate through P31.11; close D-R6.1-EVAL/D-P30.2b-1/-2 only to the extent supported, otherwise retain exact remaining obligations.
acceptance: Metrics identify tier/frame/time/source mix, fixed denominators, intervals, multiplicity and labelability; no model/holdout tuning leakage.
Failed lower-bound gate demotes or retains provisional/review-only status; small/missing sample cannot silently promote.
A passed limited tier assessment does not certify org identity or all edges; public disclosure changes only in the gated release.
tickets.gate: signed HUMAN-H5 final campaign and P32.22a frozen candidate/frame; any policy exception requires a new explicit decision
tickets.live: operator-gated: measured rules activation after offline sealed evaluation, no publication

Produce final unpublished change/suppression/evaluation disclosure and rollback packet; P32.24 validates this exact candidate, GATE-G3 signs it and P32.25 publishes it.

Failed/inconclusive evaluation produces safe provisional/review-only disclosures and cannot reuse a previously optimistic resolved count.
Changed input affecting the sample population or semantics stops for reassessment rather than silently carrying old eligibility; publication pointer remains unchanged.

tickets.live: operator-gated: frozen selected inputs/rules only, resource bounds from P32.22

No unsupported acceptance or orphan gap remains; coverage history is preserved.
